contentDrafts.showHnBody:
Show HN: GIBRAN & CO. – Build, manage, and share your brand.

Hi HN! We built GIBRAN & CO. because we were frustrated by the disconnect between internal product docs and external public brand pages.

It is a focused workspace where you organize brand guidelines, notes, and assets, and publish an instant public hub.

Built with Next.js, Firebase, and Tailwind. Would love feedback on usability and developer ergonomics!
